title: My Future Voicemail
narration: At midnight, I received a voicemail from myself—recorded tomorrow. My future voice warned me not to admit Marcus, the brother I had left to drown years earlier. He appeared outside without having aged, while another voicemail screamed that I had already opened the door. When the doorstep camera showed nobody there, I finally remembered Marcus had never returned from the lake. I wanted to leave immediately, but doing that would mean abandoning the only proof that any of this had happened. The silence felt deliberate, as though someone nearby was waiting for me to understand the trap before moving again. For several seconds I could hear nothing except my breathing and the small ordinary sounds around me. Someone locked the door behind me, and wet footprints led from the hallway to the phone in my hand.
